5.0.SP2.description: The most recent (or current) modification TransactTime <60> reported on an Execution Report <8> for the order. The OrigOrdModTime <586> is provided as an optional field on Order Cancel Request <F> and Order Cancel/Replace Requests <G> to identify that the state of the order has not changed since the request was issued. The use of this approach is not recommended.
